reviews.title: Fun-Filled Potato Passing Game for Kids and Families!
reviews.body: Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐Squirrel Products’ Tater Toss is an absolute hit in our household! This electronic plush musical potato passing game is a fantastic addition to our family game night and a go-to choice for birthday parties.The concept of passing a plush potato while the music plays adds an element of excitement and laughter that’s hard to resist. It keeps kids and adults entertained and engaged.The potato itself is soft and huggable, which adds to the overall fun. The electronic music and timer make the game thrilling, ensuring everyone is on their toes.What’s remarkable about Tater Toss is that it encourages social interaction and cooperation among players. It’s a game that brings everyone together, making it perfect for family gatherings and kids’ parties.If you’re looking for a game that combines music, laughter, and togetherness, Squirrel Products’ Tater Toss is the way to go. It’s a blast for kids and families, and we can’t get enough of it. Highly recommended for hours of wholesome fun!

features: TOSS THE TATER: It's silly playtime fun when you Toss the Tater! The whole family will be up and moving as you all try to beat the music and get rid of that tater before the music stops. Its exciting fun that will have everyone on their feet!

CLASSIC GAME: It’s a soft, plush, musical tater that you pass around just like the classic game you played as a kid. Just begin the music and start passing the potato, but don't get caught when the music stops.

WHO CAN PLAY: Everone loves classic playground games! Ideal for 2-6 players ages 4 and up, Tater Toss helps develop hand- eye coordination, balance, and is a great way to get kids away from the screen and having fun!

ACTIVE INDOOR GAMES: Play indoors or outside and get the kids off the couch and active! Boys and girls ages 4 years and up all love the excitement of this interactive children's game that anyone can play.

PLAY ANYWHERE: Tater toss is compact and portable, easy to take to the park, play indoors when it's rainy, or to play as a children's birthday party activity. It's simple active fun for everyone! Includes 3 1.5 V LRFF/ AG 13 batteries.
